title: Claire and Ron Sawyer Standing Outside, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A late 1940s black-and-white outdoor snapshot portrait of a couple, identified on the reverse as Claire and Ron Sawyer. The man wears a light-colored fedora hat, double-breasted suit jacket, and a bold patterned necktie typical of the post-WWII era. The smiling woman stands beside him wearing a short-sleeved floral print dress or playsuit. They are posed near a leafy vine-covered brick facade next to a commercial window display.
